description: This file defines the API for a dynamic array of strings ('strvec') in C, including its data structure, initialization, manipulation functions, and memory management.

methods.name: strvec_init
methods.description: Initializes a strvec struct, setting up its internal array and counters.

methods.name: strvec_push
methods.description: Adds a copy of a string to the end of the strvec array.

methods.name: strvec_push_nodup
methods.description: Adds ownership of an allocated string to the end of the array, without copying.

methods.name: strvec_pushf
methods.description: Formats a string with printf-like syntax and appends it to the array.

methods.name: strvec_pushl
methods.description: Pushes a list of strings onto the array, terminated by NULL.

methods.name: strvec_pushv
methods.description: Pushes an array of strings onto the end of the strvec.

methods.name: strvec_splice
methods.description: Replaces or inserts a range of elements in the array starting at a given index.

methods.name: strvec_replace
methods.description: Replaces the element at a specific index with a new string.

methods.name: strvec_remove
methods.description: Removes an element at a specified index, shifting subsequent elements.

methods.name: strvec_pop
methods.description: Removes the last element of the array.

methods.name: strvec_split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on whitespace and adds them to the array.

methods.name: strvec_clear
methods.description: Frees all memory used by the array and resets it to initial state.

methods.name: strvec_detach
methods.description: Detaches the internal array from the strvec structure for external management.
